rules.statement: A fidei commissum can be created even where the language of the will is open to criticism, provided there is doubt as to who are the recipients of the bounty.
rules.supporting_quote: "When the intention to substitute another (or fidei commissary) for the first taker (or fiduciary) is expressed, or is to be gathered by necessary implication from the language of the will, a fidei commissum is constituted. Where these requisites appear, it matters not that the language employed is open to criticism"
